name: Inter-X
summary: 包含骨架、SMPL-X 和文本标注的双人交互动作数据。
summaryEn: Two-person interaction motions with skeleton, SMPL-X and textual annotations.
scale: 40 interaction categories; counts depend on the selected release split
scaleZh: 40 类交互动作；规模以所选发布分割为准
access: Publisher form required for research access
accessZh: 需填写发布方表单申请研究用途访问
license: Consult publisher terms; data license not independently verified
licenseZh: 请核对发布方条款；数据许可尚未独立核实
wmNote: 论文发表于 2023 年，数据发布于 2024 年；交互顺序标注不等于受控物理干预。
wmNoteEn: The paper appeared in 2023 and data in 2024; interaction-order labels do not imply controlled physical interventions.

evidence.locator: News; Dataset Download; motion visualization and processing
evidence.statement: The released data include mocap-derived skeletal/SMPL-X motion sequences with text and interaction-order labels, plus split files and sequence visualization tools.

yearBasis.description: README dates the original paper to 2023-12-27 and the dataset release to 2024-04-16.
